newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus/Nethold merger in April.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus/Nethold merger in April.

text.p: The planned merger of French pay television group Canal Plus with Nethold will be effective mid-April and three persons from Nethold's parents MIH and Richemont will join the supervisory board on March 28.

"We have received authorisation for the merger by the countries involved -- France, Germany, Belgium, Italy, Sweden and Poland. The merger will be effective in mid-April after a similiar procedure on the Nethold side," a spokeswoman for the pay television group said.
The new supervisory board of Canal Plus will count 15 members, against 12 now including founder Andre Rousselet who is resigning.

Generale des Eaux chairman Jean-Marie Messier, his predecessor Guy Dejouany, and Paul-Louis Girardot are on the board while Havas is also represented by three members among whom is chairman Pierre Dauzier.
Industry sources said that Canal Plus, which obtains control over Italian pay-television company Telepiu with the Nethold merger, will be able to start digital television in Italy from the summer.
